svg.title: Best observed editing frontier
svg.desc: Separate xnip MCP and CLI panels compare byte-exact native and xnip minima within the same allowed-contract pool. Guarded pools admit guarded profiles only; snapshot-enabled pools admit guarded and snapshot profiles on both sides. Native executor-input candidates may span native transports. Invocation overhead is separate. Input and known-text exchange winners are independent; this is not a global optimum or an executed strategy.
svg.text: Native best / xnip best | tokens | log axis | xnip = 1x | each minimum uses every recorded byte-exact repetition
Circle: input. Diamond: input + known text. Guarded: guarded only. Snapshot-enabled: guarded + whole writes. Aider return unknown.
Native candidates span native transports. CLI invocation and request envelopes are separate costs; no timing ranking is made.
Best observed supplied profiles only. Missing comparisons remain n/a. Winners can differ between input and known-text exchange.
Full serialized JSON-RPC replies are a separate captured layer when recorded; no frontier choice is replayed by the runner.
